Nothing in Kanto produces one: the only Mew here is the Mystery Gift redeemed with the serial code inside a Poke Ball Plus, one per accessory ever made, open since the day the games went on sale and never closed - and step 7 found it is the only Mystery Gift these cartridges have ever been sent

Only through the GO Park: Pokemon GO sends into these two one way and into nothing else, and GO is not a game in this dataset - it has no Pokedex to fill and nothing in it is caught in the sense this tracker means. Doable today rather than closed, and it closes its own circle: the Mystery Box that makes Meltan appear in GO is unlocked by sending something to the GO Park in the first place. The Chinese Release Commemoration Meltan of October 2024 handed one out, and it was for the mainland Chinese cartridges rather than these: one of those Pokemon reaches an international copy only by a local trade with somebody who has that release

Only through the GO Park, and it arrives already evolved: 400 Meltan Candy makes one in Pokemon GO, where the Meltan has to be caught anyway, and nothing in Kanto can evolve the Meltan that comes out of the park. Doable today rather than closed - the park takes Kanto's 151, their Alolan forms, and these two. The Pokemon Day Melmetal of February 2025 handed one out, and it was for the mainland Chinese cartridges rather than these: one of those Pokemon reaches an international copy only by a local trade with somebody who has that release
